zh-CN.name: REA 逆向分析
zh-CN.shortDesc: 基于证据分析二进制、软件包与应用行为，也可录制网页应用生成智能体环境包。需另备受支持的 Node.js/npm、rea-agents CLI 或已注册的 REA MCP；原生分析、插桩调试、抓包与信号记录等流程需另备目标相关工具及权限，Hopper、IDA、Fiddler Everywhere 等商业提供方须另行授权付费，运行环境包还需 AgentEnv 与 Docker；代为操作浏览器、录制环境或插桩调试目标前须获授权。安装本技能仅提供指引，不安装工具或注册服务；依赖不可用时先处理阻碍，不编造结果。

en-US.name: REA: Reverse Engineer Anything
en-US.shortDesc: Evidence-led reverse analysis of binaries, packages and app behavior, plus agent environment bundles recorded from web applications. Requires supported Node.js/npm and rea-agents CLI or a registered REA MCP server; target-specific tools, permissions and any commercial provider licenses (e.g. Hopper, IDA, Fiddler Everywhere) are separate, and running an environment bundle needs AgentEnv and Docker. Agent-driven browser actions, environment recording and native instrumentation or debugging need operator authorization. Installing this skill only supplies instructions; it does not install tools or register services. Resolve missing dependencies before claiming results.
